Name: ESPERriririnTelekinesisTIME
Overview: ESPERriririnTelekinesisTIME is a 2D fixed-screen shooter. The player controls a character that must defeat square, box-shaped enemies which are constantly shooting in a straight line in front of them within a time limit. The most efficient way to achieve this is to use a combined time stop/telekinesis ability to make the enemies shoot each other, though the player can also shoot them directly too. The player's telekinesis (esper) gauge is depleted after use, but quickly fills up again a few moments later.
